triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンでの症例検出が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。武力紛争・栄養失調が流行を悪化させている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Central, Arunachal teams intensify measures to contain FMD outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 16 August 2026, joint Centre–State teams are intensifying containment of an FMD outbreak in Dibang Valley, Arunachal Pradesh, affecting Mithuns, pigs, and goats. Anini-based Rapid Response Teams arrived on 8 August, with three dedicated RRTs deployed; Tezu’s District Informatics Officer joined on 11 August for field visits and sample collection. A central team led by Joint Commissioner Dr V K Teotia arrived on 13 August and conducted field assessments on 14–15 August across Acheso, Angrim Valley, Aropo up to Chegu Camp, Mipi Circle, Maro, 9 Kilo, and Matu Camp. They engaged Mithun owners, Gaon Buras, and PRI leaders; treated infected animals, distributed medicines, collected diagnostic samples, and performed post-mortems. The Indo-Tibetan Border Police camp at Acheso was visited; goats’ blood samples were collected. FMD vaccination is biannual and vaccination drives, along with biosecurity and waste-disposal measures, are being emphasized. Central team departed Anini with samples for advanced lab testing; RRTs will remain until the outbreak subsides.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府とアルナーチャル州のチームがFMD（口蹄疫）流行封じ込め対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は家畜（ミトゥン、豚、ヤギ）に影響する動物疾患であり、人間の健康への直接的な影響やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは報告されていないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にRomania（Buzău, Anini）が含まれているが、記事内容はインド・アルナーチャル・プラデーシュ州の地名（Anini, Dibang Valleyなど）と同名の誤ジオコーディングと判断されるため除外した。本疾患は動物衛生イベントであり人間の感染症サーベイランスの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: CAG Report Finds E. Coli in Railway Station Drinking Water, Flags Lack of Basic Amenities | रेलवे स्टेशनों के पानी में 'मानव मल' वाला बैक्टीरिया! CAG रिपोर्ट ने खोली पोल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CAG Report Finds E. coli in Railway Station Drinking Water, Flags Lack of Basic Amenities | Bacteria with 'human feces' in railway stations' water! CAG report has laid bare.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-16, a Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) report found drinking water samples at Indian Railways stations contaminated with E. coli and Total Coliforms, posing infection risks to passengers. Samples from water coolers and taps were collected across eight railway zones in 2022-23 (49 stations) and nine zones in 2023-24 (56 stations). Contaminated stations include Coimbatore and Palakkad (South Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhivandi Road, Kalyan, and Lonavala; and Madhupur (East Railway). E. coli, typically from human feces, can cause food poisoning, diarrhea, and kidney injury in severe cases when ingested via contaminated water. Separately, 458 of 512 surveyed stations lacked Minimum Essential Amenities such as drinking water, seating, cleanliness, bins, and public-address systems. The report urges routine water testing under Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol and explains NSG-1 to NSG-6 station categorizations, with NSG-1 as the highest.

triage.headline_ja: CAG報告書、鉄道駅の飲料水から大腸菌を検出 基本設備の不足も指摘
triage.triage_reason: 監査報告書に基づく水質汚染の指摘であり、実際の感染症患者発生報告ではなく、緊急性・異常性も認められないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事はCAG（会計検査院）による水質監査結果の報告であり、実際の感染症発生・患者報告は記載されていない。継続的な水質管理課題として留意するに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Έμπολα "κερδίζει": Ένας άνθρωπος πεθαίνει κάθε 30 λεπτά στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola "wins": One person dies every 30 minutes in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates toward a deadly phase, with 4,660 cases and 2,184 deaths (about 47% CFR) as of 16 August 2026. Ituri province is the epicenter, with over 3,400 cases; six of 26 provinces have infections, and Uganda has 20 cases. The UN warns the outbreak could become the fastest-moving and most deadly yet, urging rapid escalation and solidarity. Funding is rising: CERF added $30.5 million, on top of $24 million already allocated, bringing CERF to $54.5 million. OCHA has deployed 20 more staff with potential for more. The WFP has expanded hot meals at treatment and isolation centers in Ituri and surrounding areas, delivering over 260,000 meals since May. The crisis is worsened by conflict in North and South Kivu and widespread malnutrition affecting about 2.6 million (more than half in Ituri), demanding expanded water, sanitation, healthcare, burial capacity, and funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが「勝っている」：コンゴ民主共和国で30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクで致死率約47%、複数州・隣国ウガンダへの拡大が確認されており、国際的な緊急対応（CERF資金拡大、OCHA人員派遣）も進行中でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20件）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。国連は本アウトブレイクが過去最速・最も致死的になりうると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera Outbreak Sickens More Than 90 in Myanmar's Biggest City
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar's largest city, with at least 93 people testing positive at a single hospital and more than 180 hospitalized with diarrhea as the outbreak that began last week spreads. One 92-year-old man has died. Cases are concentrated in downtown Yangon, many in Chinatown; contaminated water and takeaway street food are suspected sources. Authorities are disinfecting the water supply with chlorine and quarantining close contacts; 83 other hospitals in the Yangon region are preparing supplies. Outside Yangon, cases have been reported among people returning from Yangon in Kyaikkhami, Mon State (a 34-year-old man and a 59-year-old woman). A 15-year-old Yangon resident fell ill after eating fermented fish salad. The outbreak highlights Myanmar's strained health system under junta rule amid monsoon rains and flooding; WHO notes climate-related water contamination. Officials hope cases will drop within a week if plans hold.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー最大都市でコレラ流行、90人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで死者を伴うコレラ集団発生が急速に拡大し、他地域への波及や医療体制逼迫が懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: ヤンゴンでの発生に加え、モン州への波及例も報告されており、モンスーン期の水質汚染とミャンマーの脆弱な医療体制が拡大要因として指摘されている。WHOも気候関連の水質汚染に言及しており、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El eclipse del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Eclipse of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the worst crisis in the country’s history, with more than 2,000 deaths and about 4,000 infections as of 16 August 2026. World Health Organization leaders in Africa fear an unprecedented speed of transmission. On the ground, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) report limited progress in containment; while contact tracing has advanced, it remains insufficient. In some treatment centers 9 of 10 admitted patients were not traced contacts, signaling high levels of undetected spread. The report also covers the impact on children, many of whom are orphans being cared for in UNICEF facilities. It will also examine, from a scientific perspective, the current status of the Ebola vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの日食
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、死者2,000人超・感染者約4,000人、感染追跡が不十分で未検出感染が拡大している可能性が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: MSFやUNICEFなど国際機関が対応中で、感染追跡の不備により未検出感染が多い点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Cambio climático reconfigura el riesgo de malaria en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate Change Reshapes Malaria Risk in Africa
article.articleSummary: Malaria risk in Africa is shifting as temperatures rise, altering transmission patterns. West and Central Africa continue to host about 95% of global malaria cases and deaths, with Nigeria responsible for 31.9%, Democratic Republic of the Congo 11.7%, and Niger 6.1%; children under five account for roughly 76% of fatalities. The WHO has urged broader use of the RTS,S/AS01 vaccine in moderate-to-high transmission areas to curb deaths from Plasmodium falciparum, which accounts for the vast majority of infections on the continent. In pilots in Ghana, Kenya, and Malawi, RTS,S/AS01 reduced child mortality by 13.2%. Climate-driven changes may expand transmission into southern Africa and eastern highlands, where around 25°C favors transmission, while parts of the west may become too hot. Funding shortfalls cited by WHO in 2025 threaten control efforts; health systems require investment and climate-resilient strategies to adapt.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がアフリカにおけるマラリアリスクを再構築
triage.triage_reason: 既知のマラリア流行状況と気候変動による将来的リスク変化を扱う一般的・分析的記事であり、急性の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動とマラリア流行パターンの長期的変化に関する分析記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ケニア・マラウイ・ナイジェリア・ニジェール・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CAG Flags E. Coli Bacteria in Water From Coolers At 8 Stations
article.articleSummary: Eight railway stations across four zones had water cooler samples test positive for E. coli, signaling possible faecal contamination and unsafe drinking water: Coimbatore and Palakkad Junction (Southern Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan and Lonavala (Central Railway); Madhupur (Eastern Railway). The audit also found total coliforms, including E. coli, in water taps at 49 stations across eight zones in 2022-23 and 56 stations across nine zones in 2023-24. Beyond this, bacteriological tests for parameters other than total coliforms were unsatisfactory at eight stations across four zones (2022-23) and 11 stations across five zones (2023-24); 59 stations across six zones had no bacteriological testing. Across 512 non-suburban stations surveyed, 458 lacked Minimum Essential Amenities, with latrines short at 201, urinals at 403, and drinking water taps at 2,035. The CAG urged compliance with inspection protocols and comprehensive testing under the Uniform Drinking Water Quality Protocol.

triage.headline_ja: CAG(会計監査院)、8駅の水冷却器の水から大腸菌を検出と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症患者発生ではなく、インド鉄道の水質監査報告における大腸菌検出の指摘であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCAG(会計監査院)によるインド鉄道の水質・衛生設備に関する監査報告であり、実際の感染者発生や健康被害の報告はない。水質基準未達の構造的問題を指摘するもので、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: แพทย์เตือนไข้หวัดใหญ่ในผู้สูงวัย รุนแรงกว่าคนหนุ่มสาวหลายเท่า แนะเสริมเกราะป้องกัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn that influenza is far more severe in the elderly than in younger people, and urge stronger protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains a seasonal threat in Thailand, with over 1 million cases nationwide in the Thai year 2568 and more than 200,000 infections and 25 deaths in the first half of 2026. Elderly individuals aged 60+ with chronic diseases face the highest risk of severe illness and complications such as pneumonia, heart attack, and extended hospitalization. Vaccination is emphasized as a key prevention, with a fourfold higher-dose influenza vaccine designed for older adults showing greater protection than standard-dose: infection reduction by about 24.22%, influenza-related hospitalizations reduced by 31.93%, and smaller reductions in cardiovascular-related admissions (6.6%) and heart failure (21.3%) relative to standard-dose. Thailand Association of Infectious Diseases recommends considering high-dose vaccines for those aged 60+. In addition to vaccination, public health measures—mask-wearing, frequent handwashing, and avoiding crowded places—are advised, particularly before and during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が警告、高齢者のインフルエンザは若者より重症化しやすい―予防強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発・予防記事であり、異常な流行や国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する定例的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の内容。

article.articleHeadline: 苏州市相城区元和街道御苑家园社区开展虫媒传染病防控知识讲座
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yuyuan Jiayuan Community, Yuanhe Subdistrict, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou Holds a Lecture on Vector-Borne Disease Prevention and Control
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, Japanese encephalitis, and malaria were the focus of a vector-borne disease prevention lecture at Yuyuan Jiayuan Community, Yuanhe Subdistrict, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. A physician from the Community Health Service Center explained transmission, symptoms, risks, and identification of these diseases, and dispelled common misconceptions. The practical session emphasized eliminating mosquito breeding sites, home disinfection, personal protection, and draining standing water, with 'clear standing water, remove hidden corners' as the core preventive measure. Residents were advised to regularly clear plant pot saucers, discarded containers, and drains. The session used accessible language and included Q&A; health materials were distributed. No case counts or laboratory confirmations were reported. Organizers will continue routine health education, environmental sanitation, and vector control to bolster public health. A resident remarked that plant-water is the key culprit.

triage.headline_ja: 蘇州市相城区元和街道御苑家園コミュニティ、虫媒介感染症予防啓発講座を開催
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例報告や流行拡大の情報はなく、単なる地域住民向けの予防啓発講座に関する記事であるため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は症例報告ではなく、地域コミュニティにおける蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、日本脳炎、マラリア）の予防啓発活動を紹介するもの。実際の発生・流行を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola provoca una muerte cada media hora en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola causes one death every half hour in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is killing about one person every 30 minutes, according to UN humanitarian affairs chief Tom Fletcher. The fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record could become the deadliest, with the outbreak declared on May 15 and more than 4,500 cases and 2,128 deaths reported. Infections have occurred across six Congolese provinces, with cases also detected in Uganda and near the South Sudan border. Urgent actions include expanded treatment, contact tracing and prevention. Donor funding totals around $300 million, plus $30.5 million from the UN emergency fund and $24 million previously allocated. The response involves deploying new specialized staff; Fletcher urged doubling safe-burial teams and expanding treatment capacity, plus stronger water, sanitation and health services. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in DRC; this is the seventeenth outbreak in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱により30分ごとに1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラアウトブレイクで4,500例以上・2,128人死亡、複数州及び隣国への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ及び南スーダン国境付近での症例も報告されているが、ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが記事の主題国として明確。

article.articleHeadline: El cambio climático reconfigura el riesgo de malaria en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change reconfigures malaria risk in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains concentrated in Africa's western and central regions, accounting for 95% of cases and deaths. Nigeria accounts for 31.9% of fatalities, the Democratic Republic of the Congo 11.7%, and Niger 6.1%; children under five represent 76% of deaths. To curb transmission, WHO advocates broader use of the RTS,S/AS01 vaccine for Plasmodium falciparum, transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, in moderate-to-high transmission areas, with a Lancet study linking a 13.2% reduction in child mortality in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi. A Nature study shows transmission peaks near 25°C and declines below 16°C or above 35°C; warming is making southern Africa and East African highlands more suitable, while some western areas become too hot. The WHO warned in April 2025 that funding cuts threaten control efforts, underscoring that climate is not the only driver, with financing, resistance and health-system strength also critical; experts urge sustained adaptation, particularly in western and central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がアフリカのマラリアリスクを再構成する
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動とマラリア媒介蚊の生息域変化に関する一般的・長期的傾向分析記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: マラリアは西・中央アフリカに集中する既知の風土病であり、本記事は気候変動による将来的な流行分布変化を論じる分析記事。DRC・Ghanaは死亡統計やワクチン研究の文脈で言及されているが、新規の緊急事態ではないためDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: UN aid chief warns Ebola killing one person every 30 minutes in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On Aug 16, 2026, UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading yet, killing about one person every 30 minutes. The outbreak has grown to 4,449 confirmed cases and 2,061 deaths, according to Congolese authorities. Congo declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and two days later the World Health Organization designated it a public health emergency of international concern. Fletcher urged speed, scale and solidarity from the international community, noting urgent needs for clean water, sanitation, healthcare and other essential services in affected areas. About $300 million has been contributed to a fund dedicated to combating the outbreak, underscoring a critical, ongoing international response to prevent further transmission and protect more people at risk.

triage.headline_ja: 国連人道問題責任者、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により30分に1人が死亡していると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(確定4,449例、死亡2,061例)でWHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みの進行中のエボラ流行。フルRRAへ即時移行すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Puerto Rico introduced small Indian mongooses to control rats in sugarcane fields; today, they are the island's main wildlife reservoir for rabies
article.articleSummary: Puerto Rico's small Indian mongooses (Herpestes javanicus), introduced in the 1870s from India to control rats in sugarcane, became the island’s main wildlife reservoir for rabies. The first laboratory-confirmed mongoose rabies outbreak in Puerto Rico occurred in 1950, the first major Western Hemisphere outbreak in the species, and mongooses now account for about 70% of animal rabies cases on the island, with similar roles in Grenada, Cuba and the Dominican Republic. There is no wildlife vaccination program in Puerto Rico; surveillance relies on postmortem brain testing and serology. A 2015 serosurvey of 112 mongooses from El Yunque and Cabo Rojo found antibodies in 39%, while 2014–2021 testing of 464 mongooses at 11 sites found about 17% antibodies, indicating widespread but uneven exposure. Mongoose bites (~280/year) pose human risk; rabies is fatal if untreated, including a 2015 fatality. Modeling (2021 Viruses) underscores control challenges given abundance and limited data.

triage.headline_ja: プエルトリコはサトウキビ畑のネズミ駆除のためインドマングースを導入したが、今日ではこの動物が島の狂犬病の主要な野生動物リザーバーとなっている
triage.triage_reason: プエルトリコにおけるマングースの狂犬病リザーバー化に関する歴史的・生態学的な解説記事であり、対象国での新規感染急増や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はプエルトリコ・グレナダ・キューバ・ドミニカ共和国における狂犬病媒介動物としてのマングースの歴史的背景を扱ったもので、対象国（India等）は導入元として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo exige atenção a sintomas e vacinação; saiba os sinais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles requires attention to symptoms and vaccination; know the signs.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak risk in Brazil heightened by World Cup travel in 2026, with the Health Ministry issuing a June alert on imminent reintroduction and spread. São Paulo's northern zone reported 3 cases in children under 2; as of 2026, the city health authorities confirm at least 23 measles cases. A zero-dose of the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) was recommended for 6–11 months to boost protection in the most susceptible infants. Measles is highly contagious and airborne, capable of infecting up to 90% of non-immune contacts, with transmission from 6 days before to 4 days after rash onset. Key signs include fever (>38.5°C) and red rash (exanthem) with cough, conjunctivitis, or malaise; rash typically starts on the face behind the ears and spreads over 3–5 days. Complications include pneumonia (~1 in 20), acute otitis media, encephalitis, and death (1–3 per 1,000). Diagnosis is clinical but laboratory confirmation is preferred; treatment is supportive. Vaccination options include double viral, triple viral, and tetra viral vaccines; routine vaccination covers 12 months to 59 years, with catch-up for unvaccinated individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹は症状と予防接種への注意が必要；サインを知ろう
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ市で麻疹の再流行が確認され（23例）、2026年ワールドカップに伴う渡航増加によって国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省は2026年ワールドカップによる渡航増加を背景に麻疹再導入への警戒を発令しており、サンパウロ市では23例の確定例が報告されている。乳幼児を中心にワクチン接種率向上が呼びかけられている。

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo sem casos, CE cria novo protocolo para monitorar Febre do Nilo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even without cases, Ceará creates a new protocol to monitor West Nile fever.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever (FNO) and Saint Louis encephalitis in Ceará, Brazil: Ceará's Health Secretariat (Sesa) published a July technical note on prevention and surveillance, stressing no new cases or outbreaks. The arboviruses share Culex vectors and wild birds as hosts, with the viral agent potentially circulating for up to three months. The only Ceará FNO case occurred in 2019 in a Boa Viagem horse (Sertão Central); no human cases have been confirmed since. In humans, FNO and Saint Louis encephalitis range from asymptomatic to severe neurological disease; diagnosis relies on antibodies against West Nile virus in serum or CSF, with no vaccine or antiviral available. Treatment is supportive, ICU for severe cases. The note underscores ongoing surveillance, health-professional awareness, and rapid response, given vector presence and mobility. MS has not issued 2026 notices; prevention focuses on repellents and reporting bird/equine illness or death via the SISS-Geo app.

triage.headline_ja: 症例がなくてもセアラ州はナイル熱を監視する新プロトコルを作成
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で新規症例や集団発生はなく、行政の予防的な監視体制整備を報じる内容であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年の唯一の症例（馬）以降、新規症例なしと明記。行政の予防的プロトコル策定に関する報道であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा के पांच शहरों में संक्रमण और बीमारियां फैलने का खतरा, लोगों को मास्क लगाने की एडवाइजरी जारी - fatehabad sanitation crisis health alert in haryana cities
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of infections and diseases spreading in five cities of Haryana, advisory issued urging people to wear masks - fatehabad sanitation crisis health alert in haryana cities.
article.articleSummary: Five cities in Haryana—Fatehabad, Jakhal, Bhuna, Tohana, and Ratia—face a heightened infection risk as sanitation collapsed for 11 days, with about 1,210 tonnes of garbage littering streets, markets, and residential areas. As of 16 August 2026, residents are advised to wear masks outdoors due to rising filth and foul odor. Health officials warn the dumped waste raises the possibility of dengue, malaria, diarrhea, and other infections, unless cleaning resumes promptly. Citizens voice frustration over municipal failures despite tax payments; the sanitation workers’ union has extended its strike to 18 August. Vishnu Mittal, District Epidemic Disease Specialist, cautions that garbage accumulation creates disease-spreading conditions and reiterates the mask advisory until sanitation is restored. The report highlights an ongoing sanitation crisis in Fatehabad and neighboring towns.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の5都市で感染症拡大の恐れ、住民にマスク着用の勧告発令 - ファテハバード衛生危機・保健警報
triage.triage_reason: 衛生労働者のストライキによるゴミ放置がデング・マラリア等のリスクを高めているとする警告記事だが、実際の症例増加や感染症発生の報告はなく、あくまで予防的注意喚起の段階であるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症症例数の増加は報告されておらず、ゴミ収集ストライキによる衛生環境悪化がデング・マラリア等の媒介感染症リスクを高めている段階の予防的警告記事である。ストライキの推移と実際の症例報告の有無を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ரயில் நிலைய குடிநீரில் இகோலி: சிஏஜி அறிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli in the drinking water at the railway station: CAG report
article.articleSummary: On 16 August 2026, India’s Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) reported Escherichia coli in drinking-water vending machines at eight non-suburban railway stations across four zones, including Mumbai CSMT and Hyderabad. E. coli bacteria can cause food poisoning, diarrhoea, and, in some strains, kidney failure. The assessment surveyed 512 non-suburban stations; 458 stations lacked essential facilities or provided them below prescribed standards. The eight affected stations were: South Western Railway – Coimbatore, Palakkad Junction; South Central Railway – Hyderabad; Central Railway – Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Pivandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala; Eastern Railway – Madhupur. The report notes that Indian Railways operates 5,908 non-suburban stations, with over 7,424 non-suburban trains daily in 2023-24 and about 292.4 crore passengers travelled.

triage.headline_ja: 鉄道駅の飲料水からE.コリ検出：CAG報告書
triage.triage_reason: CAG（会計検査院）によるインフラ監査報告であり、実際の感染者や発病事例の報告はない。水質基準未達の指摘に留まり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はCAGによる鉄道駅の飲料水設備監査結果の報告であり、実際の患者発生や健康被害の記述はない。感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではなくインフラ監査ニュース。

article.articleHeadline: Dead lizard in birthday cake leaves 11 hospitalised in Maharashtra's Nalasopara
article.articleSummary: 11 people in Nalasopara, Maharashtra (7 children and 4 women) were hospitalised with suspected food poisoning after eating a birthday cake that allegedly contained a dead lizard. They developed sudden stomach and chest pain soon after the celebration; all were treated and reported stable, with no deaths or critical illness. Details about the cake’s bakery supply were not immediately available. The incident raises food-safety concerns about hygiene and quality checks at bakeries and food outlets. In a separate Maharashtra case, a rat was seen in an ice-cream freezer at a Blinkit store in Kalyan’s Godrej Hill area, prompting calls for action and renewed questions about quick-commerce hygiene. Additionally, FSSAI suspended the licence of a Blinkit-associated establishment in Malad West after violations, as authorities increase scrutiny of fast-delivery food facilities. The report does not cite laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州ナラソパラで誕生日ケーキに死んだトカゲが混入、11人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑いの単発的な食品衛生事案であり、感染症の公衆衛生危機や国際的拡大リスクを示す要素がない。全員安定しており死亡例もない。
triage.notes: 感染症事案ではなく食品衛生（異物混入）に関する報道。ラボ確認もなく、感染症サーベイランスの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: रेल यात्रियों की सेहत से खिलवाड़, CAG रिपोर्ट में खुलासा, स्टेशनों के पीने के पानी में मिला जहरीला बैक्टीरिया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tampering with the health of railway passengers, CAG report reveals, toxic bacteria found in the drinking water at stations.
article.articleSummary: India’s CAG warns drinking water safety at non-suburban railway stations is compromised. In a 2019–20 to 2023–24 audit of 512 stations, E. coli and total coliform were detected in water coolers/taps at major hubs, including Mumbai CSMT, Kalyan, Lonavala, Bhiwandi Road; Coimbatore, Palakkad Junction; Hyderabad; and Madhupur (Eastern Railway), plus NSG‑1 stations such as New Delhi, Howrah, Sealdah, Mumbai Central and CSMT. Six zones had 59 stations with no bacteriological testing. Across 2022–23 and 2023–24, 49 and 56 stations respectively showed total coliform in tap water. Sanitation also faltered: 2,035 stations lacked adequate water taps, 403 lacked sufficient urinals, 201 toilets were below standards, and 89% of stations lacked minimum facilities. The report urges uniform drinking-water quality protocols and regular inspections to safeguard public health, with no illness counts provided.

triage.headline_ja: 鉄道旅行者の健康を軽視、CAG報告書で判明 ― 駅の飲料水から有毒細菌検出
triage.triage_reason: インド会計検査院(CAG)による水質監査報告であり、実際の感染症発生・症例報告はなく、行政・インフラ問題としての性質が強いため。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019-20〜2023-24年の監査結果を示す行政報告であり、実際の疾病発生や患者数の報告はない。水質管理の構造的問題を指摘するもので、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 6 người phơi nhiễm với đàn chó nghi mắc bệnh dại ở Thanh Hóa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people exposed to a pack of dogs suspected of having rabies in Thanh Hoa.
article.articleSummary: Six people in Thanh Hóa Province were exposed to five young dogs in Thanh Hương, Thanh Quân commune, Như Xuân district, suspected of rabies. The dogs, from two families, were unvaccinated. From late July, some dogs showed abnormal behavior and began biting people. One white dog bit a person, then drooled and died; another dog became aggressive and continued biting. That dog was moved to another household, where it again acted abnormally and bit the owner, children, and a neighbor. By 14 August, at least six people were linked to the dogs, including bites and exposure while handling after death; several sought care late. In April 2026 only 121 of 140 dogs were vaccinated (86.4%). Như Xuân CDC and Thanh Hóa CDC mobilized risk assessment, vaccination, and rabies immunoglobulin; authorities urged vaccination and dog management. Wash wounds with soap for 15 minutes, seek medical evaluation, and avoid home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: タインホア省で狂犬病疑いの犬の群れに6人が曝露
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既知の風土病であり異常性は低いが、複数人が曝露し予防接種率も不十分なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が高く、犬のワクチン接種率不足（86.4%）が継続的な曝露リスクを示唆。地域のCDCが対応中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le gouvernement congolais appelé à renforcer la riposte dans les provinces touchées - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Congolese government urged to step up the response in the affected provinces - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 16 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak prompts renewed calls from the coalition The Congo Is Not for Sale (CNPAV) for an intensified, transparent, community-centered response in the affected provinces. The group urges Kinshasa to immediately strengthen the response, protect the population, and ensure transparent management of funds. It notes that warnings raised since June by CdC/RN about a more locally anchored, transparent response were insufficiently heeded. After a 5 August Task Force meeting with the government, WHO and Africa CDC, authorities acknowledged the need to revise outbreak strategy and boost involvement of communities, traditional and religious leaders, and civil society. The epidemic, which began in Ituri, has spread to five provinces with more than 2,000 deaths; field reports cite care, coordination, and payroll difficulties. PM demanded a detailed report on funds; CNPAV calls for an urgent parliamentary inquiry into funding, payments, coordination, and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ政府に被害州での対応強化を求める声 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し死者2000人超と深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はイトゥリ州で始まり5州に拡大、死者2000人超。WHO・Africa CDCとのタスクフォース会議が実施され、資金管理の透明性を巡り議会調査を求める声も上がっている。国際的拡大リスクは明記されていないが、地域拡大の状況から高い懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 133 Students Hospitalized in Suspected Food Poisoning Linked to Free Meals Program
article.articleSummary: 133 students at Baiti Jannati Islamic boarding school in Sukabumi, West Java, were hospitalized with dizziness, nausea, diarrhea and vomiting after meals from the government’s free nutritious meals program on Aug 14, with symptoms arising the next day; a female teacher was affected as well. Some patients were treated at Al-Mulk Regional Hospital, then referrals to Syamsudin Regional Hospital. The Sukabumi Health Agency has asked for a comprehensive investigation and guidance on food handling under the program. An epidemiological inquiry is underway; investigators have collected food samples and students’ vomit for laboratory testing, with some samples sent to the West Java provincial health laboratory. Results are expected in about a week to identify the cause and any implicated pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: 無料給食プログラムに関連した食中毒疑いで学生133人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑いによる集団発症事例だが、感染症（病原体由来）かどうか不明で、原因究明中のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来疾患）の疑いであり、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。原因物質（細菌性、化学性など）の特定が待たれる段階。政府プログラムに関連するため社会的関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Trabajadores sanitarios del Congo luchan por mantenerse de pie mientras el ébola avanza más rápido que el rastreo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers in the Congo struggle to stay on their feet as Ebola advances faster than contact tracing can keep up.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province, centered in the Nizi health zone, is advancing faster than contact tracing can keep up. Community health workers led by Gédéon Banga Ngbape investigate about 60–70 alerts daily and monitor contacts, but surveillance now detects 60–70% of new cases among people not being watched as contacts. The outbreak has surpassed 4,700 cases and over 2,200 deaths, the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s history, outpacing 2014–2016 West Africa losses. No vaccines or approved treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; clinical trials are underway. Frontline workers face PPE shortages, self-purchased disinfectants, and salary delays; the Nizi treatment center briefly closed during a strike. The UN and Africa CDC have mobilized $30.5 million in emergency funding; government payroll delays and mining-related population movements complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの医療従事者、エボラの拡大が追跡調査の速度を上回る中で奮闘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ史上最速の拡大を見せ、4700例・2200人以上の死者を出しており、ワクチン・治療薬もなく国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ・イトゥリ州ニジ保健地区でのBundibugyoエボラウイルス流行に関するもの。発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文では言及がなく除外した。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 26 مليون إصابة و30 ألف وفاة بالملاريا بالكونغو في 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 26 million malaria cases and 30,000 deaths in Congo in 2025
article.articleSummary: As of 16 August 2026, authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 26,064,143 malaria cases and at least 29,938 malaria-related deaths in 2025. Malaria remains the country’s leading public health problem, requiring coordinated, collective interventions. Despite intensified efforts, the disease burden continues to strain the health system and communities. The government recently distributed mass drug administration to accelerate control. The report aligns with World Health Organization observations that malaria kills hundreds of thousands in Africa annually, with young children as the primary victims.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、2025年にマラリア感染2,600万件以上、死者3万人
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおける既知の風土病であり、今回の報告は2025年通年の統計まとめであるため『異常・予想外』とは言えないが、規模が極めて大きく公衆衛生への負荷が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC保健当局による2025年通年のマラリア統計報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な増加を示すものではないが、症例数・死亡数の規模が非常に大きく、医療システムへの継続的な負荷が示唆されるため、続報（対策状況・WHOの評価等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ट्रेन यात्रियों के लिए बड़ा खतरा.... रेलवे स्टेशनों के पानी में मिला खतरनाक ई-कोली, CAG रिपोर्ट में खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A major threat to train passengers: Dangerous E. coli found in water at railway stations, revealed in CAG report.
article.articleSummary: From CAG audits of Indian Railways’ Non-Suburban Stations (2019-20 to 2023-24), E. coli is detected in drinking water at several major stations, including Mumbai CST, Mumbai CSMT, Kalyan, Lonavala, and Bhiwandi Road water coolers; Coimbatore Junction and Palakkad Junction coolers also contaminated, with Hyderabad station testing positive. Madhupur station water failed standards. Total Coliforms appeared in platform taps at 49 stations in 2022-23 and 56 stations in 2023-24. Of 512 audited stations, 458 lacked minimum amenities or fell short of standards. PAMS shows 2,035 stations without water taps; 403 with insufficient toilets; 201 with toilets below standard. NSG-1 hubs (New Delhi, Howrah, Sealdah, Mumbai Central, CSMT) also lacked seats, fans, water coolers, dustbins, and train information boards. The report urges uniform drinking-water quality protocols and stringent monitoring to curb waterborne gastrointestinal risks for passengers.

triage.headline_ja: 列車乗客への大きな脅威…鉄道駅の水から危険な大腸菌検出、CAG報告書で判明
triage.triage_reason: CAG(会計検査院)によるインフラ監査報告であり、実際の感染症症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、感染症シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は鉄道インフラの水質監査結果を報じたものであり、実際の感染症症例数や発症報告は含まれていない。潜在的な水系感染リスクの指摘に留まるため、症例発生の続報があればWATCHへ格上げを検討する。

article.articleHeadline: कई रेलवे स्टेशनों के पानी में मिला ई-कोलाई, सीएजी रिपोर्ट में कई कमियां सामने आईं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli found in the water at several railway stations, several deficiencies surfaced in the CAG report.
article.articleSummary: E. coli and total coliform bacteria were detected in drinking-water samples from water coolers at Coimbatore, Palakkad Junction, Hyderabad, CSMT Mumbai, Bhiwandi Road, and Kalyan. A Comptroller and Auditor General audit of 512 non-suburban railway stations across 16 zones found 458 (89%) with at least one minimum essential amenity deficiency; only 54 were fully compliant. Major hubs—New Delhi, Howrah, Mumbai Central, CSMT, Ahmedabad, Chennai Central, and Secunderabad—also lacked basic facilities. Gaps included 138 stations without drinking-water taps; 111 without toilets; 59 without urinals; 21 without waiting areas. Disabled access was deficient at many stations (227 ramps; 297 lacking accessible taps; 134 lacking toilets; 490 without dedicated seating). Emergency medical rooms were absent at 441 stations. About ₹5,956 crore (36–44% of funds) remained unspent; 59% of 395 passenger-facility projects were delayed. Recommendations urge stronger MEA enforcement, sanitation, regular water testing, shelter, disability facilities, and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: 複数の鉄道駅の飲料水からE.コリ菌検出、CAG報告書で多数の不備判明
triage.triage_reason: CAG監査報告に基づくインフラ・設備不備の指摘記事であり、実際の感染事例や健康被害の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は鉄道駅の水質・設備管理に関する会計監査報告であり、実際の疾病発生・症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Глава гуманитарной организации ООН: Эбола распространяется рекордно быстро - MigNews - Новости Израиля и Мира на русском языке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Head of the UN humanitarian organization: Ebola is spreading at a record pace - MigNews - News of Israel and the World in Russian
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented pace, threatening to overwhelm the humanitarian response, according to Tom Fletcher, UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs. He warned that the current outbreak is advancing faster than any previously observed, creating an acute need to scale up operations now. The UN official stressed that existing humanitarian capacities may be insufficient to curb the epidemic and protect affected populations. The situation is deadly, with a death roughly occurring every 30 minutes. Fletcher called on the international community to intensify support for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and to prevent further spread, emphasizing that the speed of the outbreak requires immediate action and additional resources to save lives.

triage.headline_ja: 国連人道機関トップ：エボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、国連が国際支援の緊急強化を訴えている重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 国連高官による声明であり、死亡率・拡大速度ともに深刻。既存のエボラ流行の急速な悪化を示すシグナルとしてフルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 26 مليون إصابة و30 ألف حالة وفاة بالملاريا بالكونغو الديموقراطية في 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 26 million malaria infections and 30,000 malaria deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reached a devastating level in 2025, with 26,064,143 confirmed infections and at least 29,938 deaths. Officials note that despite ongoing control efforts, the disease continues to place a heavy burden on the health system and communities across the country. The 2025 figures reflect ongoing malaria transmission and the need for sustained investment in prevention, diagnosis and treatment, vector control, and surveillance. The World Health Organization notes that malaria deaths remain in the hundreds of thousands across Africa annually, with young children as the primary victims. The article underscores the continued public health challenge and the imperative to intensify efforts to reduce transmission and fatalities in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で2025年にマラリア感染2600万件超、死亡3万人に
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて既知の風土病であり、突発的・異常な事象ではないが、感染規模・死亡数が非常に大きく公衆衛生上の負担が継続しているため、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は2025年通年のマラリア統計報告であり、急激な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。ただし感染・死亡規模が極めて大きく、継続的な監視と支援の必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Reports 26 Million Malaria Cases In 2025
article.articleSummary: DRC’s 2025 malaria burden totaled approximately 26,064,143 cases and 29,938 deaths, per Guy Esebe Dembo, Deputy Director of the National Malaria Control Programme (PNLP). Malaria remains the DRC’s main public health challenge. The Ituri province launch of a mass administration campaign for antimalarial drugs is part of a broader effort to strengthen prevention and response. Dembo urged consolidating high-impact interventions and evaluating new approaches tailored to the realities of different health zones to curb transmission. The initiative calls on authorities, healthcare professionals, partners, and communities to intensify actions to reduce incidence and fatalities, with the campaign framed as a key step in the ongoing national malaria control strategy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、2025年のマラリア症例が2600万件と報告
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCで既知の風土病であり、本記事は年間統計報告であって突発的な異常事象ではないが、死亡者数約3万人という高い疾病負荷とイトゥリ州での大規模投薬キャンペーンの開始は継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCの風土病であり、本記事は2025年の年間集計に基づく報告。突発的なアウトブレイクではなく既存の国家マラリア対策プログラムの一環としての大規模投薬キャンペーン開始が主内容。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 26 مليون إصابة بالملاريا خلال عام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 26 million malaria cases in a year.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities report 26,064,143 malaria cases and at least 29,938 malaria deaths in the past year. Guy Dimbo, deputy director of the National Malaria Control Program, said despite ongoing control efforts, the malaria burden remains heavy on the health system and communities. The data underscore the continued toll of malaria in Africa, where the World Health Organization notes hundreds of thousands die annually and children are the most affected. The report reflects figures up to the 2026-08-16 period, highlighting a persistent public health challenge in the country’s malaria control. No details are provided on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported malaria cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、年間で2600万件以上のマラリア感染を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて既知の風土病であり、突発的・異常な事象ではないが、感染者数・死亡者数の規模が大きく公衆衛生上の負荷が続いているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は年次統計報告であり、新規の異常事象を示すものではない。マラリアはDRCの既知の風土病であるため、突発的なアウトブレイクとしてのシグナル性は低いが、規模の大きさから経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola s'étend au Bas-Uélé, désormais six provinces touchées par l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola spreads to Bas-Uele, now six provinces affected by the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bas-Uélé reporting its first confirmed case on 12 August 2026, bringing the outbreak to six provinces. As of the ministerial briefing on 14 August, 918 people have recovered since the start, including 32 new recoveries. On 11 August, 111 new confirmed cases were recorded: 98 in Ituri, 18 in North Kivu, and 2 in Haut-Uele, though the published daily tally lists 118 cases across these provinces—an arithmetic discrepancy that authorities will clarify. No new cases were reported in Tshopo or Sud-Kivu during the period. Response measures include vaccination with the rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine (Zaïre strain) and Remdesivir for patients. Authorities also highlighted school-year continuity measures and ongoing cholera surveillance, aiming to prevent further spread while strengthening health protections.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラがバス・ウエレ州に拡大、これで6州が流行の影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で6州に拡大し、新規感染者数も多く、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: コレラのサーベイランスも言及されているが、記事の主題はエボラの拡大である。新規症例数に集計上の不整合があり当局が確認中との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Journée mondiale du moustique : la RDC face au paludisme à l'ère du nouveau vaccin(Héritier Matenga) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Mosquito Day: the DRC faces malaria in the era of the new vaccine (Héritier Matenga) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains the world’s second-largest malaria burden, reporting 29,123,262 malaria cases and 21,695 deaths in the reference year, with about 26.3 million uncomplicated and 2.74 million severe cases. Children under 5 bear 47.7% of cases and 69% of deaths (~15,000 lives), while pregnant women account for roughly 1.5 million cases. Globally, the DRC shoulders nearly 12% of malaria burden, second only to Nigeria. In response to insecticide and drug resistance, the country has introduced the R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine into routine immunization for infants, administering four doses from 6 months of age, with trial efficacy above 75% and produced at scale by Oxford University. Authorities stress that vaccination complements—not replaces—vector control: continue insecticide-treated nets, eliminate standing water, and maintain environmental sanitation. World Mosquito Day on Aug 20 spotlights malaria and other mosquito-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界蚊の日：新ワクチン時代におけるDRCのマラリア対策（Héritier Matenga）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるマラリアの既知の風土病負荷に関する年次統計とワクチン導入の啓発記事であり、突発的な異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではないため。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCにおいて既に風土病として確立されており、本記事は世界蚊の日に合わせた啓発・統計報告およびR21/Matrix-Mワクチン導入の紹介記事。ナイジェリアは比較対象として言及されているのみで、イベントの主題国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết vào mùa cao điểm, cảnh báo những điểm nóng mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever enters peak season, warns of new hotspots.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is entering peak season with rising cases in Hanoi, Hai Phong, and Dak Lak amid monsoon. In Hanoi, 1,308 dengue cases were recorded from early 2026 to Aug 9 in 115 of 126 communes/wards, with no deaths. The city mobilized 30,675 vector-control teams and 65,931 workers, and 69 communes have proactive prevention/vaccination plans. Challenges include a thin health workforce, inexperienced staff, insufficient funds for rapid-response teams, limited volunteer networks, and uneven communication. In Hai Phong, 153 cases and 18 outbreaks were recorded by Aug 9, with six active outbreaks in Hai An, Tu Ky, An Truong, Le Ich Moc, and Nam Trieu (two in Nam Triệu). Dak Lak reports over 500 dengue cases in a week, with 160 outbreaks (67 active, 93 ended) since January, totaling over 3,100 cases. Dengue has four serotypes; adults account for over half of cases; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がピークシーズンに入り、新たなホットスポットに警戒
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの季節性デング熱の増加は例年見られる現象であり、死亡例も報告されていないが、複数省で症例数増加と対応上の課題（人員・資金不足）が指摘されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ハノイ、ハイフォン、ダクラクなど複数省でデング熱症例が増加中だが、死亡例なし。季節性の流行であり、地元当局が既に対策を主導している。人員・資金不足などの課題があるため、拡大傾向が続く場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ரயில் நிலையக் குடிநீரில் ஆபத்தான ஈ.கோலை பாக்டீரியா: விதிகளை மீறிய ரயில்வே நிர்வாகத்தை எச்சரிக்கும் சி.ஏ.ஜி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous E. coli bacteria in railway station drinking water: CAG warns the railway administration for violating the rules.
article.articleSummary: Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) findings reveal dangerous Escherichia coli and coliform bacteria in drinking water from water coolers at eight major Indian Railways stations—Coimbatore, Palakkad Junction, Hyderabad (South Central Railway), Mumbai CST, Pivandi Road, Kalyan, Lonavala, and Madhupur (Eastern Railway)—based on samples from 49 stations. The report flags serious violations of drinking-water quality rules and gaps in chlorination and routine testing. Several stations did not test for residual chlorine or for bacterial and chemical contaminants, indicating substandard water quality. Across 2022-23 (49 stations in eight zones) and 2023-24 (56 stations in nine zones), coliforms were detected in drinking-water supplies. Additionally, in 11 zones, 179 stations did not conduct chemical tests, and in 6 zones, 77 stations did not perform timely tests. Railway Ministry responded in Sept 2025 that actions are underway; CAG urges stronger compliance and oversight to ensure safe drinking water for passengers.

triage.headline_ja: 鉄道駅の飲料水に危険な大腸菌:規則違反で会計検査院が鉄道当局に警告
triage.triage_reason: CAG(会計検査院)による過去の水質監査報告であり、実際の症例発生や健康被害の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: これは特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、会計監査による水質管理の不備指摘記事。症例数や健康被害の報告はなく、インフラ・規制順守に関する行政上の問題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 2.272 morts et un taux de létalité alarmant de 46,9% - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 2,272 deaths and an alarming fatality rate of 46.9% - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused 2,272 deaths among 4,843 confirmed cases, a fatality rate of 46.9%, as of 16 August 2026. Ituri remains the epicenter, with about fifty health zones affected across six provinces: Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Currently, 777 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and 1,006 have recovered. Contact tracing coverage improved to 83.2%. A new treatment center opened in Mongbwalu to strengthen clinical care. Declared on 15 May, transmissions may have occurred as early as February. The human toll is severe in conflict‑affected areas, with logistical challenges and distrust hindering response, while cross-border risk with Uganda prompts regional surveillance and precautionary measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者2,272人、致死率46.9%という深刻な水準に - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率46.9%、死者2,272人に及ぶ大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、複数州に拡大し、ウガンダとの越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダとの越境リスクが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。感染は2026年2月頃から発生していた可能性があり、5月15日に公式宣言。紛争地域での対応困難と住民の不信感が課題として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Is drinking water at railway stations safe? Inside CAG's E. coli findings and two decades of warnings
article.articleSummary: Eight railway stations showed E. coli in water-cooler samples: Coimbatore and Palakkad Junction (Southern Railway); Hyderabad (South Central Railway); Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Bhiwandi Road, Kalyan and Lonavala (Central Railway); and Madhupur (Eastern Railway). Total coliforms, including E. coli, were found in drinking-water samples from platform taps at 49 stations in eight zones during 2022-23 and 56 stations in nine zones during 2023-24. The audit also flagged systemic testing gaps: bacteriological analysis not carried out at 59 stations across six zones; chemical analysis not conducted at 179 stations across 11 zones; testing not performed at prescribed frequency at 77 stations; residual-chlorine testing not carried out at 78 stations across 13 zones; and multi-parameter field test kits not provided at 436 stations across 15 zones. The findings echo nearly two decades of warnings, with earlier audits highlighting unsafe water at major stations such as Mumbai CST, Mumbai Central, Chennai Central and Chennai Egmore, and continuing shortcomings at Palakkad.

triage.headline_ja: 駅の飲料水は安全か？CAG(会計検査院)の大腸菌検出結果と20年にわたる警告の実態
triage.triage_reason: 会計検査院による過去の水質監査報告に基づく既知の構造的問題を扱った記事であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクや新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、インド鉄道駅の飲料水質に関する会計検査院(CAG)の監査結果を報じたもの。E.coli検出は水質管理の構造的問題を示すが、具体的な患者発生や症例報告は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu acompanha cinco casos de esporotricose em gatos e reforça orientações à população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu monitors five cases of sporotrichosis in cats and reinforces guidelines for the public.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-16, Botucatu, São Paulo, Brazil, is monitoring five cat cases of sporotrichosis, with Environmental Health Surveillance reinforcing guidance to identify symptoms and prevent transmission. Sporotrichosis is a fungal infection affecting animals and humans; cats can harbor high fungal loads in lesions, increasing transmission risk via scratches, bites, or contact with wounds and secretions. In cats, non-healing facial or paw lesions are a key sign; other signs include loss of appetite, weight loss, sneezing, nasal discharge, and behavioral changes. In humans, nodules that evolve into ulcers on hands, arms, legs, or face can occur, sometimes with pain or fever. Transmission occurs through bites or scratches or contact with infected animals or contaminated environments (e.g., thorns, wood splinters). Prevention emphasizes indoor cats, neutering, and regular checks; seek veterinary care for cats and health care for people via SUS. Early detection aims to interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: ボトゥカトゥ、猫のスポロトリコーシス5例を監視し住民への注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: 小規模な猫のスポロトリコーシス症例（5例）であり、人への感染拡大や重症化の報告もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية .. أكثر من 26 مليون إصابة بالملاريا وقرابة 30 ألف وفاة خلال عام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 26 million malaria infections and about 30,000 deaths in a year.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains the leading public health problem in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 26,064,143 confirmed malaria cases and 29,938 malaria-attributable deaths reported in the past year. Guy Dimbo, Deputy Director of the National Malaria Control Programme, emphasized that despite intensified efforts, the disease continues to impose a heavy burden on the health system and communities. The government recently distributed mass antimalarial drugs to accelerate control efforts. The article notes that malaria continues to kill hundreds of thousands of people annually across Africa, with young children as the primary victims, according to the World Health Organization. The findings highlight persistent, country-wide transmission in the DRC and the need for sustained, collective interventions to reduce morbidity and mortality from malaria.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：年間2600万人以上のマラリア感染、約3万人死亡
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはDRCにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は年間統計報告であって新規の異常な発生や急激な変化を示すものではない。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCで長期的に流行している風土病であり、本記事は国家マラリア対策プログラムによる年次統計発表。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく、既存の公衆衛生課題の継続的報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 26 مليون إصابة و30 ألف وفاة بالملاريا في الكونغو خلال 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 26 million malaria cases and 30 thousand deaths in Congo during 2025
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 26,064,143 malaria cases and 29,938 malaria-related deaths in 2025, despite ongoing control efforts and a heavy burden on the health system and communities. Gai Dimbo, deputy director of the National Malaria Control Programme, stated the figures reflect the country’s endemic malaria burden. The report emphasizes that malaria remains a major public health challenge in the DRC, with young children among the most affected. The World Health Organization is cited as noting that malaria kills hundreds of thousands of people annually across Africa, underscoring the ongoing need for strengthened interventions to reduce transmission and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で2025年にマラリア感染2,600万件、死亡3万人
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCにおける2025年通年のマラリア罹患・死亡統計の報告であり、流行の急増や異常な事象を示すものではなく、既知の風土病負担の年次報告に留まるため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの国内マラリア対策プログラムによる年次統計報告であり、突発的な流行拡大や新規異常事象を示す情報は含まれていない。既知の風土病負担としてのモニタリング対象に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Makin Ganas! Ebola Bundibugyo di Kongo Menewaskan Lebih dari 2.100 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Growing More Deadly! Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Congo has killed more than 2,100 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in an intense transmission phase, representing the largest Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak on record in DRC. As of 12 August 2026, the WHO reports 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths (case fatality rate ~46.8%). Began in Mongbwalu Health Zone, Ituri Province, and has spread to 54 health zones across six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. Bas-Uélé reports a newly confirmed case in Buta with prior travel to Haut-Uélé; symptom onset on 4 August. In epidemiologic week 32 (3–9 August 2026), 579 new cases and 304 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly totals to date. Humanitarian crisis, insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement complicate control. National authorities, with WHO and partners, are scaling up response activities to curb further geographic spread.

triage.headline_ja: さらに凶悪化！コンゴのブンディブギョ・エボラ、死者2,100人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける過去最大規模のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行が急拡大しており、致死率約47%、複数州への拡大と国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが4,665症例・2,184死亡（CFR約46.8%）と報告、6州54保健地区に拡大しており、越境移動や治安不安が制御を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Anthrax warning: Dead hippopotamus tests positive in Rutshuru territory of North Kivu, DRC
article.articleSummary: Anthrax confirmed in a hippopotamus found dead in Vitshumbi, Rutshuru territory, North Kivu, DRC. Carcass discovered August 8 in Virunga National Park; residents had already collected some meat before laboratory confirmation. Health authorities urge monitoring of exposed individuals, identifying those who handled or consumed the meat, and strengthening surveillance for cases with unusual skin lesions, fever, or general deterioration after contact with the animal or its products; report suspected cases immediately. Residents are advised not to touch carcasses or butcher/eat meat from animals found dead under unknown circumstances. Rutshuru sits in an Ebola-affected province and is under M23 rebel control, complicating oversight. Anthrax transmits to humans via handling or eating infected animal products; person-to-person spread is unlikely. In humans, three forms exist—cutaneous, inhalation, and intestinal—with symptoms varying; antibiotics greatly reduce fatalities when treated early.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽菌警告：DRC北キブ州ルチュル準州でカバの死骸が陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 武装勢力(M23)支配下かつエボラ対応中の地域で炭疽菌感染動物の肉を住民が既に摂取しており、監視体制の脆弱性と国際支援の必要性から精査が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌はヒト-ヒト感染しないため大規模流行の可能性は低いが、既に肉を摂取した住民への健康影響と、M23支配下・エボラ対応地域という複雑な状況下での対応能力の脆弱性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 上月全省新冠感染逾7.1萬宗　流感約43萬宗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Last month, COVID-19 infections in the province exceeded 71,000 cases, while influenza infections were about 430,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 2026 (last month) in Guangdong Province, COVID-19 infections exceeded 71,000 with 0 deaths, while influenza infections reached about 430,000 with 2 deaths. The province reported over 618,000 statutory infectious-disease cases in total, with 113 deaths; Category A produced no cases or deaths. Category B accounted for over 112,000 cases and 111 deaths, led by COVID-19 infection, hepatitis B, syphilis, tuberculosis, and gonorrhea, which together comprised more than 96% of Category B reports. Category C saw about 505,000 cases and 2 deaths, dominated by influenza, hand-foot-mouth disease, and other infectious diarrheal diseases, making up about 99.9% of Category C. No reported cases or deaths occurred for SARS-related pneumonia, poliomyelitis, rabies, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, anthrax, meningitis, or schistosomiasis.

triage.headline_ja: 先月、広東省の新型コロナウイルス感染者数は7万1000件超、インフルエンザは約43万件
triage.triage_reason: 定例の感染症統計報告であり、通常の季節性疾患動向を示すのみで、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 広東省の月次法定感染症統計報告。COVID-19・インフルエンザとも季節性の範囲内で、死亡率も低く特段の異常は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Rail passengers' health at risk: CAG report reveals toxic bacteria in drinking water at railway stations
article.articleSummary: Total Coliform and E. coli detected in drinking water at major Indian railway stations, per CAG audit of 512 non-suburban stations from 2019-20 to 2023-24, revealing serious health risks to millions of rail passengers. E. coli found in water coolers at Mumbai’s Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Kalyan, Lonavala, and Bhiwandi Road; also at Coimbatore and Palakkad Junction in Southern Railway, and Hyderabad in South Central Railway; Madhupur in Eastern Railway also failed quality tests. Total Coliform detected in taps at 49 stations (2022-23) and 56 stations (2023-24). 59 stations had no bacteriological testing at all. The report notes dilapidated toilets and severe amenity shortages: 2,035 stations without adequate taps; 403 lacking urinals; 201 with toilets below standards; 89% overall lacking minimum amenities, including seating, water, and information boards. CAG urges immediate reforms and uniform drinking-water quality inspections.

triage.headline_ja: 鉄道旅客の健康リスク：CAG報告書がインド鉄道駅の飲料水から有害細菌を検出したことを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド会計検査院(CAG)による過去5年間(2019-2024)の水質監査報告であり、実際の感染症発生・症例報告ではないため、感染症シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、鉄道駅の飲料水質に関するインド会計検査院(CAG)の監査結果報告。具体的な症例数・患者数の記載はなく、インフラ管理上の問題として扱うべき事案。継続的な水質管理の欠如という構造的リスクはあるが、急性の公衆衛生危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 4665 حالة مؤكدة للإيبولا و2184 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 4,665 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,184 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths as of 12 August 2026 (case fatality rate 46.8%). The outbreak, one of the largest in DRC history, has expanded from the Mongabwalo health zone to 54 health zones across six provinces, including Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Bas-Uele province has the highest burden with one confirmed case linked to travel from Haut-Uele. In week 32, 579 new cases and 304 deaths were reported, indicating ongoing transmission. Response efforts are led by national authorities in collaboration with the World Health Organization, who are expanding control activities. Uganda has ended the inbound case surveillance but remains at risk for reintroduction due to continued transmission in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱確認症例4,665件、死亡2,184人
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(致死率46.8%、6州54保健区に拡大)が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境リスクの文脈で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは入国者監視を終了しているが再導入リスクありとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Cachorro não passa leishmaniose para humanos; entenda como ocorre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog does not transmit leishmaniasis to humans; understand how it occurs.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis in Brazil is addressed, clarifying that dogs do not transmit the disease directly to humans; transmission occurs via the sand fly infected with the protozoan Leishmania infantum. Dogs can be infected for months before showing signs, which include weight loss, reduced appetite, hair loss, non-healing wounds, eye changes, nail overgrowth, and enlarged lymph nodes; without veterinary care, organ systems may be affected. Humans are impacted, and the issue is a public health problem in Brazil, highlighted by the Agosto Verde-Claro prevention campaign. Prevention priorities span both animals and environments: continuous use of repellent collars, vaccination where indicated, insecticidal products, and proper environmental management to reduce sand fly habitats. Home practices include yard cleaning, debris removal, waste control, and screens for kennels. Early veterinary consultation and a One Health approach are essential to break the transmission cycle and reduce year-round risk.

triage.headline_ja: 犬は人間にリーシュマニア症を感染させない；その仕組みを解説
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病に関する一般啓発記事であり、異常な流行や新規事象を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera outbreak spreads across Yangon as more than 180 people hospitalised
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar, with 93 confirmed cases at a single hospital, over 180 hospitalised, and one death (92-year-old man). Cases concentrated in downtown Yangon, especially Chinatown. Contaminated water and takeaway street food suspected as sources; authorities tracing residence and travel to map spread. Health authorities preparing supplies at 83 other Yangon-region hospitals and prioritising water safety; Yangon General Hospital is equipped but others may lack capacity. Reports of cases outside Yangon in Mon State among travelers returning from Yangon (34-year-old man and 59-year-old woman). 15-year-old Sithu Phyo infected after eating fermented fish salad; dehydration and leg cramps; treated with IV fluids. Myanmar's health system weakened by civil war; UNICEF notes large unvaccinated child population. Heavy monsoon rains and floods risk water contamination; WHO warns climate change worsens conditions. Authorities injecting chlorine into pipelines and quarantining close contacts; expected case reduction within a week if response proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: ヤンゴンでコレラ流行が拡大、180人以上が入院
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで確認例93件・入院180人超・死亡1名のコレラ流行が発生し、モン州にも拡大。内戦で脆弱化した保健システムと未接種人口を背景に、更なる拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: モン州への拡大は帰省者経由でありミャンマー国内での地理的拡大。国際的な越境拡大は現時点で報告なし。UNICEF・WHOが状況に言及しており国際的関心が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Illegal crossings complicate Ebola surveillance as DR Congo presses Uganda
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has spread to six provinces. Uganda closed its border with the DRC on May 27, driving people to illegal routes known as panyas and complicating surveillance, with official crossings limited to authorised teams, humanitarian workers, cargo and security personnel under strict health screening. A Uganda–DRC cross-border surveillance meeting in Mbarara, under the Great Virunga Transboundary Collaboration, aims to boost surveillance, information sharing and laboratory cooperation, adopting a One Health approach and streamlined sample transport. Near-border areas include Mponde, Kasindi, Beni and Butembo, within roughly 60–80 km of Uganda. Uganda, declared Ebola-free, is considering easing restrictions while expanding crossing categories to include schoolchildren, medical travellers, humanitarian workers, security personnel and traders under strict SOPs. The Great Virunga Landscape spans about 24,000 sq miles across Uganda, Rwanda and DRC, home to about two million people, and is being prepared for broader outbreak readiness.

triage.headline_ja: 違法越境がエボラ監視を複雑化、コンゴ民主共和国がウガンダに対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が6州に拡大し、ウガンダとの国境地帯での越境感染リスクが高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行とウガンダとの国境管理・監視協力に焦点を当てている。ウガンダとルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。近隣国境地域（Mponde, Kasindi, Beni, Butembo）はDRC国内の地名。

article.articleHeadline: Study warns of measles risk with 1.7 million Australians vulnerable
article.articleSummary: 1.7 million Australians are not protected against measles (about 7%), risking larger outbreaks; 2019 measles susceptibility and overall immunity stand at 93.3%. The World Health Organization target is 93–95% for herd immunity, and Australia, though measles-eliminated in 2014, still reports imported cases from overseas travel. Recent cases in adults aged 20–40 are largely tied to travel to Asia (Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand). Higher susceptibility is noted among infants and young children, and adults born in 1993–1995, 2000, and 1977–1983, reflecting gaps in second-dose uptake; those born before 1966 may be unvaccinated or partially vaccinated but could have lifelong immunity from past infection. If herd immunity falls below 93%, outbreaks become harder to control and can occur in pockets with lower coverage. Recommendations: travellers should verify vaccination records and obtain two doses if needed, and adults in at-risk groups should consider boosters; GPs should assess measles status before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 研究:170万人のオーストラリア人が麻疹に対して脆弱、アウトブレイクリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はオーストラリアの麻疹に対する集団免疫低下を扱う研究報告であり、フィリピン・ベトナム・タイは輸入症例の渡航先として言及されているに過ぎず、これら対象国での実際のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオーストラリアの麻疹感受性研究。フィリピン・ベトナム・タイは渡航歴のある輸入症例の文脈でのみ言及され、これらの国自体でのアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため対象国リストから除外した。オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Έρευνα: Λόγω ξηρασίας η πρώτη επιδημία κίτρινου πυρετού στη Βραζιλία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research: Due to drought, the first yellow fever outbreak in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever returned to Brazil—the first outbreak in almost 80 years since 1942—amid a severe drought, according to a Science article. Brazil had kept the disease in check through extensive vaccination and vector control. In 2017, cases spread to multiple Brazilian cities, infecting more than 2,000 people over two years and killing over 700. Symptoms range from influenza-like illness to jaundice, hemorrhage, and organ failure in severe cases. A modeling study published in Science Advances proposes that the 2017 drought altered mosquito dynamics and human exposure, driving transmission and outbreak despite prior vaccination successes and typical humidity-linked risk. The findings highlight drought as a potential catalyst for yellow fever resurgence in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 調査：干ばつが原因で、ブラジル初の黄熱病流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2017年に発生した黄熱病流行とその後の科学的研究（干ばつとの関連性）を報告する回顧的な学術記事であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は2017年のブラジル黄熱病流行に関するScience Advances誌の研究成果を紹介する科学報道であり、現在進行形の新規アウトブレイクではない。過去の事例の再分析のため、現行のシグナルトリアージ対象としては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Health worker strike disrupts Ebola response in Eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-16, Eastern Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak has 4,381 confirmed cases and 2,011 deaths, the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Declared May 15, sequencing shows it began in February. In Nizi, surveillance head Gédéon Banga Ngbape reports health workers unpaid for over three months and limited mobility hindering field operations; the Nizi Treatment Center briefly closed after a Thursday strike. Surveillance receives about 60–70 alerts daily, while staff report lacking basic protective supplies. The Bundibugyo virus currently has no approved vaccines or treatments, though trials are underway. Strikes by unpaid workers, rebel threats, and misinformation have significantly impeded the response in this challenging setting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でヘルスワーカーのストライキがエボラ対応を混乱させる
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで、確認症例4,381人・死者2,011人と甚大な公衆衛生影響があり、医療従事者のストライキやワクチン未承認など対応体制の脆弱性も深刻なため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキ、反政府勢力の脅威、誤情報の拡散など対応を著しく阻害する要因が多数存在。史上最速拡大とされる点は特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Demand to install advanced screening systems in blood banks in Kerala to detect infections
article.articleSummary: Demand to install advanced NAT screening systems in government and private blood banks in Kerala follows reports of HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C infections among college students nationwide. Blood donors come from college students; thousands of patients with thalassemia, sickle cell disease, haemophilia, aplastic anaemia, leukaemia rely on transfusions. Rising viral infections among young donors prompt concern. In Karnataka, KSAPS-backed camps for HIV testing in colleges show infections among 18–35-year-olds rising from 44,500 in 2023–24 to 66,600 in 2025–26, with over 7,000 diagnoses in the 18–25 group. Reports of transfusion-related infections from Haryana and Madhya Pradesh accompany Kerala push. Kerala cases include thalassemia patients diagnosed with Hep B and C after transfusion; an HIV-infected child underwent bone marrow transplant in Bengaluru and may take two years to test negative. Advocates urge NAT screening everywhere, awareness campaigns, curriculum updates, and a policy for lifelong care and compensation for transfusion infections.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州の血液銀行に高度なスクリーニングシステム導入を求める声、感染症検出のため
triage.triage_reason: 輸血関連感染症（HIV、B型・C型肝炎）の増加が複数州で報告されているが、新興感染症の急速な拡大というより既存の医療システム課題であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。国内の公衆衛生政策議論として継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 血液製剤・輸血を介した既知の血液媒介感染症（HIV、Hep B/C）の国内における増加事例であり、新興感染症のアウトブレイクではない。ケララ、カルナタカ、ハリヤナ、マディヤ・プラデーシュなどインド国内複数州にまたがる医療システム上の課題として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ONU alerta: ébola mata uma pessoa a cada meia hora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns: Ebola kills one person every half hour.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with 2,184 deaths since it was declared on May 15, the UN reports. The virus is gaining ground, with Tom Fletcher warning it is spreading faster than the response and killing one person every 30 minutes. The UN has added $30.5 million to the Central Emergency Response Fund (CERF), on top of the $24 million already allocated to DRC and neighboring countries. Response teams at the epicenter have been expanded by 20 personnel; six of the 26 provinces have reported cases; Uganda has notified 20 cases. WFP extended hot meals to more treatment centers amid conflict in North and South Kivu, and Ituri province—hosting half of DRC’s 2.6 million severely malnourished people—remains the main focus. Food-security funding is only 25% funded; calls for safer and dignified burials, enhanced contact tracing, and WASH support to accelerate the response; world must act.

triage.headline_ja: 国連警告：エボラは30分に1人を死亡させている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、2,184人が死亡、複数州及び隣国ウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダで20例確認との報告があるが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。国連が緊急対応資金を追加投入するなど、国際的関与が拡大している。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose: entenda o que é a doença e como se proteger do quadro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis: what it is and how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis in Botucatu, Brazil, is transmitted to humans by the sand fly (mosquito-palha) after it bites an infected animal; the parasite Leishmania chagasi is acquired by the vector from dogs or other animals and then transmitted to people. Cutaneous leishmaniasis starts as a small skin lesion that slowly enlarges into an ulcer over weeks to months; persistent changes in the nose, mouth, or throat may signal mucosal involvement. The visceral form is more severe, with fever lasting more than two weeks, weight loss, profound fatigue, reduced appetite, and abdominal enlargement; severe cases can cause anemia, weakness, and immune compromise, increasing susceptibility to other infections. Prevention emphasizes environmental hygiene (removing leaves, organic material, and trash) to reduce sand fly breeding, plus repellents, screens on doors/windows, and protective clothing from dusk to dawn when the vector is active.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア症とは何か、その予防法について解説
triage.triage_reason: リーシュマニア症に関する一般的な啓発・予防情報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はリーシュマニア症の疾患説明・予防啓発が主目的であり、具体的な症例数急増やアウトブレイク発生の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la riposte contre Ebola fragilisée par le manque de moyens
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola response weakened by a lack of resources.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as the fastest-growing in the country’s history, centered around Nizi with community teams investigating exposed individuals. Government data released overnight report 4,381 confirmed cases and 2,011 deaths. Although the outbreak was declared May 15, sequencing indicates transmission began in February. Response is strained by chronic resource shortages: health workers unpaid for over three months, limited field mobility, and a temporary closure of the Nizi treatment center after staff strikes. Surveillance handles 60–70 alerts daily, but responders often lack basic protective equipment. The Bundibugyo strain is rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment, though clinical trials are underway. Factors such as unremunerated staff, rebel threats, community anger, and widespread misinformation significantly hinder the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:資金不足によりエボラ対応が弱体化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が発生し、致死率高く承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的拡大リスクと対応能力の逼迫が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 4,381症例・2,011死亡と致死率約46%と非常に高く、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の希少株(ブンディブギョ)。医療従事者未払い、治療センター閉鎖、反乱勢力の脅威、誤情報拡散など対応が著しく困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola preocupa autoridades e OMS alerta para avanço rápido da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak worries authorities, and WHO warns of the rapid spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are advancing at a concerning pace. The World Health Organization reports over 4,300 cases and more than 2,000 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. Genetic analyses indicate the virus circulated from February. The episode is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; there is no vaccine or treatment approved specifically for this variant. WHO aims to reduce transmission in the next three months, but projections warn the outbreak could last six to twelve months depending on health teams’ reach, case finding, and interruption of transmission chains. The eastern DRC faces remote, conflict-affected regions near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda, complicating response due to limited infrastructure, misinformation, and health worker strikes. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and potential hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が当局を悩ませ、WHOが病気の急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4,300症例以上、死亡2,000人超）で、国境地域への拡大リスクとワクチン・治療薬未承認の状況からIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダが含まれるが、記事本文では国境近接地域としての言及のみで、実際の症例発生は明記されていないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : des médecins ougandais déployés au Nord-Kivu pour renforcer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Ugandan doctors deployed to North Kivu to bolster the response.
article.articleSummary: Ugandan medical team deployed on 15 August 2026 to North Kivu, DRC, to bolster provincial coordination of the Ebola response. Led by Prisca Luanda Kamala, chief health coordinator for the North Kivu Military Governor. In Beni, they visited Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs/CTEs) to assess operations, supply availability, isolation and triage capacity, and biosafety compliance by staff. They discussed contact tracing, management of suspected cases, and coordination with partners including INRB and WHO. In the afternoon, the mission moved to Butembo, focusing on the Katwa health zone, a major hotspot for the 17th Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain. Similar evaluations were conducted at other centers to identify urgent needs for PPE and medicines. Kamala reaffirmed governmental commitment to mobilize resources to stop transmission and urged communities to use health facilities and follow preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダの医師団が対応強化のため北キブ州に派遣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）に関する報告であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダからの医療支援チーム派遣に関する内容だが、発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州）であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。既知の第17次エボラアウトブレイクの継続報告だが、致死率の高い疾患であり継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: പാലക്കാട് തെരുവുനായയുടെ കടിയേറ്റ പശു പേവിഷബാധയേറ്റ് ചത്തു

The family, who rely on cattle and goat farming, received post-exposure rabies vaccination from a veterinary doctor after the attack. A second cow sustained minor injuries in the same incident and is currently reported healthy. In the Vaniyamkulam panchayat, residents note persistent stray dog trouble across several localities. The event highlights ongoing rabies risk from stray dogs and its impact on livestock livelihoods, with no reported human cases in the article. triage.headline_ja: パラッカドで野良犬に噛まれた牛が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（牛）1頭の狂犬病による死亡事例であり、人的被害の報告はなく、インドの農村部で野良犬由来の狂犬病は珍しくないため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
